i18n.enTitle: How does an AI agent work? Easy-to-understand explanation of the four components and their working flow
i18n.enSummary: Even if you hear that "AI agents operate autonomously," don't you find it difficult to explain what is happening inside? The structure of the AI ​​agent is such that the LLM acts as the brain, and uses tools and memory to repeatedly "think, act, and confirm." If you introduce it without knowing how it works, you may misjudge the scope and authority you are entrusted with, leading to erroneous operations and information leaks. On the other hand, if you understand the mechanism, you can judge for yourself whether the vendor's proposal is reasonable.
